content_sections.heading: AAI Co Pilot Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Co Pilot : 10+2 (with physics & mathematics) from a recognized board/university, Current valid CPL issued by DGCA, India with a minimum of 500 flying hours on multi engine, Current FRTOL issued by DGCA, India, Current IR Endorsement, Current RTR (A) or RTR (P) or RTR (C) issued by WPC, ministry of communication, India, Current class-1 medical fitness certificate issued by DGCA, India, Valid ELP, Candidates should be in possession of Indian current passport, Minimum of 1000 total flying hours required. Experience: Minimum 500 flying hours on multi engine, Minimum 1000 total flying hours required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Airports Authority of India (AAI) for hiring aviation professionals on a contract basis across India.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this AAI recruitment?
faq.answer: The position available is Co-Pilot (P2)-Beechcraft B350/B360 under the Airports Authority of India.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Co-Pilot (P2)-Beechcraft B350/B360 post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for AAI Co-Pilot Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the duly filled application form via email is 20-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply through Email by sending their scanned application and supporting documents to the specified addresses.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Applicants must have passed 10+2 with physics & mathematics and possess a current valid CPL issued by DGCA, India with minimum 500 flying hours on multi-engine aircraft.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Co-Pilot (P2) posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is up to 60 years, which is extendable up to 65 years for re-engaged candidates as per guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a negotiable monthly package starting from Rs. 2.50 lakhs per month onwards.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for AAI Co-Pilot recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises scrutiny of applications followed by a personal interview for shortlisted eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF and application format?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF, application format Annexure-I, and direct links are available in the Important Links section of this article.
